description: Internal JSON feed (no UI) for one activity's incident rows, offset-paged. Prefer engine_open_cockpit.

activityId.description: Activity id whose incidents to page

name: engine_activity_incidents_data
title: Activity incidents data (internal)

description: Internal JSON feed (no UI) for the process flow: what runs at each element of a process now, or what the instances started in the last 30 days passed there, over every deployed version. Prefer engine_open_cockpit.

source.description: runtime = what runs at each element now, summed over every deployed version; history = what the instances started in the last 30 days passed (history level activity or higher)

name: engine_activity_statistics_data
title: Activity statistics data (internal)

description: Internal JSON feed (no UI): one deployed process definition's BPMN 2.0 XML, by id, which every diagram in the views draws. Use engine_get_process_definition_xml for the XML itself.
name: engine_bpmn_xml_data
title: BPMN XML data (internal)

description: Claim a user task for a specific user.
name: engine_claim_task

description: Internal JSON feed (no UI) for one failure cluster's detail. Prefer engine_open_cockpit.

activityId.description: Activity id of the failure cluster.

businessKeyLike.description: Narrow the affected-instance list by business key (substring; % wildcards allowed).

incidentType.description: Incident type of the cluster, e.g. "failedJob".

messageSignature.description: Normalized failure-message signature (as produced by the engine-health clusters). Omitted → all messages for this activity + type.

name: engine_cluster_detail_data
title: Cluster detail data (internal)

description: Internal JSON feed (no UI) for the cockpit overview: per-definition stats. Prefer engine_open_cockpit.
name: engine_cockpit_overview_data
title: Cockpit overview data (internal)

description: External-task WORKER protocol: complete an external task that was previously fetched and locked by the given worker, optionally setting variables. The process continues as if the worker had done the work.
name: engine_complete_external_task

description: Complete a user task by ID, optionally setting variables. A task with form fields is submitted as its form: the engine enforces them (required, readonly, types); omitted fields keep their value. A delegated task (delegationState PENDING) is resolved back to its owner instead and stays open (outcome "resolved"). Never write back a value read with truncated: true. It is incomplete; read it whole first (variableName).
name: engine_complete_task

description: Correlate a message to a waiting catch event or a message start event; target it via processInstanceId, businessKey or correlationKeys. Unless all=true the engine needs EXACTLY one match: several fail, and so does none without a message start event.

processVariables.description: Set on the instance the message reaches; only correlationKeys match

name: engine_correlate_message

description: Deploy BPMN process definitions and other resources to the engine. Supports duplicate filtering and deploy-changed-only. WARNING: deploying runs code inside the engine JVM, since expressions, scripts and listener/delegate references in the deployed models execute with the engine's privileges. Available only in the admin toolset with ENGINE_ALLOW_DEPLOYMENTS=true.

enableDuplicateFiltering.description: Skip deployment if identical resources already deployed

resources.description: Each name must be unique within the deployment

content.description: Resource content (BPMN XML, DMN XML, etc.)

name.description: Resource file name (e.g. "process.bpmn"); the resource is deployed under it, so it must not contain a double quote, a backslash, "=?" or control characters, nor start or end with whitespace

name: engine_create_deployment

description: Generate a migration plan from a source process definition to a target process definition. The plan contains activity-id mappings for activities that exist in both versions; pass it verbatim to engine_migrate_process_instances_async.

updateEventTriggers.description: If true, instructions between events are configured to update the event triggers.

name: engine_create_migration_plan

description: Delete (cancel) a running process instance by ID. Irreversible; cascades to the instances its call activities started (unless skipSubprocesses) and cancels the calling activity if it was itself called.

skipCustomListeners.description: Skip custom execution listeners (e.g. when one fails the delete)

skipSubprocesses.description: Keep the instances its call activities started (default: deleted too)

name: engine_delete_process_instance

description: External-task WORKER protocol: fetch and lock external tasks for the given worker id. Locked tasks are withheld from the production workers until the lock expires (default 5 minutes) or the task is completed or failed; there is no unlock. To inspect external tasks without locking them, use engine_list_external_tasks.

variables.description: Variable names to include in the response

name: engine_fetch_and_lock

description: Build a structured, tracker-agnostic ticket draft (title, markdown body, labels) from a Camunda 7 / CIB seven incident. Does NOT file anything: present the draft in the chat for review and reuse; the user decides where it goes (their issue tracker via whatever integration is available, the prefilled GitHub URL of the configured repository, or copy-paste).
name: engine_format_incident_issue

description: Get the activity instance tree of a running process instance. Shows which activities are currently active.
name: engine_get_activity_instance_tree

description: Status of a batch from a batch tool: running, failing (batch jobs out of retries; it cannot finish until they are retried), suspended or completed, with job counts while it runs.
name: engine_get_batch

description: Get a deployment by ID: its timestamp and source, for pre/post deployment correlation (commit hash → deployment ID → timestamp).
name: engine_get_deployment

description: Get the exception stacktrace of a failed job, condensed to the exception lines, the Caused-by chain and user-code frames (framework frames trimmed). stacktrace is null when the job has none or no longer exists.
name: engine_get_job_stacktrace

description: Get the BPMN 2.0 XML of a process definition by ID. Returns the raw BPMN XML string.
name: engine_get_process_definition_xml

description: Get all variables of a process instance (Json/Xml/Object: serialized string + valueInfo).

variableName.description: Return only this variable, whole (never cut)

name: engine_get_process_instance_variables

description: Get details of a single user task by ID.
name: engine_get_task

description: Load the form schema for a user task from its embedded BPMN form definition (`<camunda:formData>`): fields (type, required, readonly) pre-filled with current values. Never submit readonly fields. Without form fields, fields is empty and formKey (or formRef, a linked Camunda Form) names the task's own form, if any.
name: engine_get_task_form

description: Get all variables of a user task (Json/Xml/Object: serialized string + valueInfo).

variableName.description: Return only this variable, whole (never cut)

name: engine_get_task_variables

description: External-task WORKER protocol: report a failure for an external task locked by the given worker. Sets the error message, the REQUIRED remaining retries and the retry timeout; retries = 0 raises an incident at once.
name: engine_handle_external_task_failure

description: Internal JSON feed (no UI) for the engine health verdict + incident clusters. Prefer engine_open_cockpit.
name: engine_health_data
title: Engine health data (internal)

description: Internal JSON feed (no UI) for one process instance's activity history, ended instances included. Prefer engine_open_cockpit.
name: engine_history_timeline_data
title: History timeline data (internal)

description: Internal JSON feed (no UI) for a single incident: stacktrace, BPMN with the failing activity, variables, activity tree, history. Prefer engine_open_cockpit.
name: engine_incident_detail_data
title: Incident detail data (internal)

description: Internal JSON feed (no UI) for the incidents dashboard: open incidents grouped by process. Prefer engine_open_cockpit.
name: engine_incidents_data
title: Incidents dashboard data (internal)

description: Where one process instance waits and why, running or ended: root-cause incidents, called instances. Select by processInstanceId, businessKey or processDefinitionKey.
name: engine_inspect_process_instance

description: Internal JSON feed (no UI) for a single process instance. Prefer engine_open_cockpit.
name: engine_instance_detail_data
title: Instance detail data (internal)

description: Internal JSON feed (no UI) for the cross-engine overview: one engine's executable, suspended and later-due jobs and its external tasks. Prefer engine_open_cockpit.
name: engine_job_backlog_data
title: Job backlog data (internal)

description: Internal JSON feed (no UI) for jobs. Prefer engine_open_cockpit.

failedOnly.description: Show only failed jobs (no retries left)

name: engine_jobs_data
title: Jobs data (internal)

description: List deployments.
name: engine_list_deployments

description: List the configured engines, grouped by environment (`environments` maps each to its engine ids), plus the default engine (`defaultEngineId`, null when none).
name: engine_list_engines

description: List external tasks (service-task work handed to external workers). Read-only: it never locks, completes or fails a task (noRetriesLeft finds the failed ones; where the toolset allows engine writes, engine_set_external_task_retries hands them back to their workers).

locked.description: true = only tasks locked now (lock not expired)

noRetriesLeft.description: true = only failed tasks (0 retries, an incident exists)

notLocked.description: true = only tasks not locked (no lock, or it expired)

withRetriesLeft.description: true = only tasks with retries > 0 (or not set yet)

workerId.description: The worker that most recently locked the task

name: engine_list_external_tasks

description: List incidents (errors) in the engine: failed jobs, external task failures, etc.
name: engine_list_incidents

description: List jobs (timers, async continuations).
name: engine_list_jobs

description: List deployed process definitions (key, name, version, deployment).
name: engine_list_process_definitions

description: List running process instances.

withIncidents.description: true = only instances with an open incident

name: engine_list_process_instances

description: List user tasks. Each task carries ID, name, assignee, process info, and timestamps.

candidateGroup.description: Tasks offered to this group: only UNASSIGNED ones unless includeAssignedTasks

includeAssignedTasks.description: With candidateGroup: include tasks already claimed

name: engine_list_tasks

description: Queue a batch that migrates process instances to another definition version (mapping generated from equal activity ids unless instructions are given). Returns { batchId, status: "queued" }, not the outcome: follow it with engine_get_batch.

instructions.description: Explicit activity mappings. Omit to generate them from equal activity ids (as engine_create_migration_plan).

name: engine_migrate_process_instances_async

description: Modify a running process instance by moving tokens. Supports cancel, startBeforeActivity, startAfterActivity, and startTransition instructions.

activityId.description: Activity ID to start before/after or cancel

name: engine_modify_process_instance

description: Show the user the operations cockpit on one engine; they navigate it without further tool calls. `view` picks where it opens, by default the overview: the health verdict from the open incidents, the top failure clusters and every process. instance-detail needs a running instance; history shows ended ones too. You get that view's facts as compact JSON.

focus.description: process-detail: focus on its incidents; if none, list processes that have some.

messageSignature.description: cluster-detail: a failure message signature (the overview's topCluster); omitted: all.

name: engine_open_cockpit
title: Open Cockpit

description: Internal JSON feed (no UI) for the unified definition view: header, KPIs (incl. failed jobs), BPMN overlays, activity-grouped incidents. Prefer engine_open_cockpit.

processDefinitionKey.description: Process definition key to drill into

name: engine_process_incidents_data
title: Process incidents data (internal)

description: Internal JSON feed (no UI) for a definition's running instances. Prefer engine_open_cockpit.

active.description: true = only running (non-suspended) instances, false = only suspended.

businessKeyLike.description: Filter by business key (substring; % wildcards allowed).

processDefinitionKey.description: Process definition key whose instances to list. Omit for ALL running instances engine-wide.

search.description: Search box: business key (substring) or whole process instance id. Replaces businessKeyLike.

suspended.description: true = only suspended instances, false = only running.

withIncidents.description: true = only instances that currently have an open incident.

name: engine_process_instances_data
title: Process instances data (internal)

description: Query historic activity instances, i.e. which BPMN activities were executed in a process instance.

processDefinitionId.description: This engine query has no key filter

name: engine_query_historic_activity_instances

description: Query historic incidents (open and resolved, with createTime/endTime) to tell a systemic failure (the same activity failing across instances, since when) from a one-off; the runtime incident list forgets resolved ones.
name: engine_query_historic_incidents

description: Query historic process instances (completed and running).

withIncidents.description: true = only instances that had an incident (open or resolved)

name: engine_query_historic_process_instances

description: Query historic task instances (completed and open user tasks).
name: engine_query_historic_task_instances

description: Query historic variable instances, i.e. variable values from process history (serialized, with valueInfo).

variableName.description: Values stay cut, even for one name

name: engine_query_historic_variable_instances

description: Resolve a custom incident by ID. The engine refuses failedJob/failedExternalTask (400); retry those instead: engine_set_job_retries / engine_set_external_task_retries on the incident's configuration id.
name: engine_resolve_incident

description: Set the retries of an external task. Retries > 0 hand a failed task back to its workers and clear its failedExternalTask incident (engine_resolve_incident cannot resolve that incident type); 0 raises an incident. Never locks, completes or fails the task itself.
name: engine_set_external_task_retries

description: Set the number of retries for a failed job. Setting retries > 0 will re-execute the job.
name: engine_set_job_retries

description: Queue a batch that sets retries on multiple jobs. Returns { batchId, status: "queued" }, not the outcome: follow it with engine_get_batch.

dueDate.description: New due date; a past one runs the jobs at once

name: engine_set_job_retries_batch

description: Set the suspension state of a process instance. suspended=true suspends it (jobs, timers, and message correlations are frozen); suspended=false activates (unsuspends) it again.
name: engine_set_process_instance_suspension

description: Set a single variable on a process instance; pass back the valueInfo read. Never write back a value read with truncated: true. It is incomplete; read it whole first (variableName).
name: engine_set_process_instance_variable

description: Set the assignee of a user task.
name: engine_set_task_assignee

description: Start a new process instance by process definition key. Optionally set a business key and initial variables.
name: engine_start_process_instance

description: Triage of one engine: findings by severity, overall status and counts.
name: engine_status

description: Throw a signal: an ENGINE-WIDE broadcast, not a targeted call. It triggers every matching signal catch event in every running process instance and starts a new instance through every matching signal start event. Cannot be undone or scoped to one instance (use engine_correlate_message for targeted delivery).
name: engine_throw_signal

description: Unclaim (release) a user task, removing the current assignee.
name: engine_unclaim_task

description: Internal JSON feed (no UI): which engine write actions the widgets may offer in this deployment.
name: engine_widget_actions_data
title: Widget actions (internal)
